test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 13 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

LAMP : RQGT : : GAME : GQGO : : GOAT : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

 
• First letter → (8) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series diagonally.
 
• Second letter → (6) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series diagonally.
 
• **Third **letter → (4) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series diagonally.
 
• Fourth letter → (2) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series diagonally.

​So,

 
• LAMP : RQGT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13ac53fe030a117025548874e61f9ff7f1347c4cc1a389507d2d84067f8c6fda.png] 

​And,

 
• GAME : GQGO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a1a554713545a4a55bae1c9eea0f7ed96d08bfe8ad5e8755edb2537a57f01e6.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• GOAT : ?

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6a9041f406d2f94b3a1de285f1012dc3e26666a3d9fc6c40ca08bda28dac4f4b.png] 

Hence, "**VEUO**" is the correct answer.

86:Tf9
